record.paper_title: Some Open Problems Related to Fixed Point Properties
record.original_question: Let A be an F-algebra. If A is left amenable, so that A has topological left invariant means on its dual M = A*, under what conditions is the vector space spanned by the set of topological left invariant means on A finite dimensional?

evidence.quote: The F-algebra A is left amenable if there is a topological left invariant mean (abbreviated TLIM) m on A∗ = M, i.e. if there is m ∈ M∗ such that kmk = 1 and hm, ϕ·fi = hm, fi for all f ∈ M and all ϕ ∈ A with kϕk = h1, ϕi = 1 ...
Problem 2.3. Suppose that the F-algebra A is left amenable. When is the space spanned by the set of topological left invariant means on A finite dimensional?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $A$ be an F-algebra in the following sense: $A$ is a Banach algebra that is the unique predual of a $W^*$-algebra $M$, so that $M = A^*$, and the identity $1$ of $M$ is a multiplicative linear functional on $A$. Define
$$P(A) = \{\varphi \in A : \|\varphi\| = \langle 1, \varphi\rangle = 1\}.$$
For $\varphi \in A$ and $f \in M$, define $\varphi \cdot f \in M$ by $\langle \psi, \varphi \cdot f\rangle = \langle \psi\varphi, f\rangle$ for all $\psi \in A$.

A topological left invariant mean (TLIM) on $A$ is an element $m \in M^*$ with $\|m\| = 1$ such that
$$\langle m, \varphi \cdot f\rangle = \langle m, f\rangle \quad \text{for all } f \in M \text{ and all } \varphi \in P(A).$$
The algebra $A$ is called left amenable if there exists at least one TLIM on $A$. Let $\mathrm{TLIM}(A) \subseteq M^*$ denote the (convex) set of all TLIMs on $A$.

Problem. Suppose $A$ is a left amenable F-algebra. Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on $A$ under which the linear span of $\mathrm{TLIM}(A)$ in $M^*$ is finite dimensional.
artifact.status_search_result: Classical results by Granirer characterize finite dimensionality of the span of (topological) left invariant means for amenable semigroups and locally compact groups in terms of finiteness/structural conditions, but a corresponding general characterization for arbitrary left amenable F-algebras (in the sense of Lau) does not appear to be available in the literature. The problem is posed as an open problem and recent surveys on fixed-point properties for F-algebras do not report a complete solution.

status_evidence.title: On amenable semigroups with a finite-dimensional set of invariant means
status_evidence.snippet: Characterization: dimension of span of left invariant means is n iff G is finite and a union of n finite disjoint subgroups each a left ideal.
status_evidence.claim: Finite-dimensional span of LIMs is characterized for semigroups, but not in the F-algebra generality posed here.

status_evidence.title: Topological Invariant Means
status_evidence.snippet: Studies TLIMs on locally compact groups; does not provide a general F-algebra characterization.
status_evidence.claim: Existing literature treats group/semigroup cases; the F-algebra question remains posed as a problem.
